def fill_cardinal(grid):
 out=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
 for col,co in components(grid):
  if len(co)!=1: continue
  r,c=co[0]
  card=[grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)) if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w]
  cnt=Counter(card)
  n=max(cnt.values()); tops=[x for x,v in cnt.items() if v==n]
  if len(tops)>1:
   nonbg=[x for x in tops if x!=bg]
   if len(nonbg)==1: choice=nonbg[0]
   else:
    # tie-break by diagonal evidence, then most global area (excluding bg)
    diag=Counter(grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in ((r-1,c-1),(r-1,c+1),(r+1,c-1),(r+1,c+1)) if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w)
    m=max(diag.get(x,0) for x in tops); ds=[x for x in tops if diag.get(x,0)==m]
    choice=max(ds,key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
  else: choice=tops[0]
  out[r][c]=choice
 return out

program='''from collections import Counter


def _components(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while stack:
                x, y = stack.pop()
                component.append((x, y))
                for dx, dy in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
                    if (0 <= nx < height and 0 <= ny < width
                            and (nx, ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny] == color):
                        seen.add((nx, ny))
                        stack.append((nx, ny))
            result.append(component)
    return result


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(color for row in grid for color in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    diagonals = ((-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1))
    for component in _components(grid):
        if len(component) != 1:
            continue
        r, c = component[0]
        neighbors = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in
                     ((-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1))
                     if 0 <= r + dr < height and 0 <= c + dc < width]
        adjacent = Counter(grid[x][y] for x, y in neighbors)
        max_count = max(adjacent.values())
        candidates = [color for color, count in adjacent.items() if count == max_count]
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            nonbackground = [color for color in candidates if color != background]
            if len(nonbackground) == 1:
                replacement = nonbackground[0]
            else:
                diagonal_counts = Counter(
                    grid[r + dr][c + dc] for dr, dc in diagonals
                    if 0 <= r + dr < height and 0 <= c + dc < width
                )
                best_diagonal = max(diagonal_counts[color] for color in candidates)
                candidates = [color for color in candidates
                              if diagonal_counts[color] == best_diagonal]
                replacement = max(candidates, key=lambda color: counts[color])
        else:
            replacement = candidates[0]
        output[r][c] = replacement
    return output
'''
program_dir=p.parent
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p, p.stat().st_size)

program2='''from collections import Counter


def _components(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while stack:
                x, y = stack.pop()
                component.append((x, y))
                for dx, dy in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
                    if (0 <= nx < height and 0 <= ny < width
                            and (nx, ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny] == color):
                        seen.add((nx, ny))
                        stack.append((nx, ny))
            result.append(component)
    return result


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    color_counts = Counter(color for row in grid for color in row)
    background = color_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    components = _components(grid)
    component_at = {cell: i for i, component in enumerate(components) for cell in component}

    for component in components:
        if len(component) != 1:
            continue
        r, c = component[0]
        neighbors = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in
                     ((-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1))
                     if 0 <= r + dr < height and 0 <= c + dc < width]
        adjacent_counts = Counter(grid[x][y] for x, y in neighbors)
        highest = max(adjacent_counts.values())
        candidates = [color for color, count in adjacent_counts.items() if count == highest]

        if len(candidates) == 1:
            replacement = candidates[0]
        else:
            adjacent_components = {
                color: {component_at[cell] for cell in neighbors if grid[cell[0]][cell[1]] == color}
                for color in candidates
            }
            if background in candidates and any(
                    color != background and len(ids) > 1
                    for color, ids in adjacent_components.items()):
                replacement = background
            else:
                foreground = [color for color in candidates if color != background]
                if len(foreground) == 1:
                    replacement = foreground[0]
                else:
                    replacement = max(candidates, key=lambda color: color_counts[color])
        output[r][c] = replacement
    return output
'''
